Historical transfers: 18–19 October 2026 (F1 checks) and 23 October 2026 ([#203](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/203)). The 23 October comparison used the frozen [20 October A7 record](../results/joint-recalibration-170/amendment-7/restricted-2/fit/usable-budget-endpoint.json), `e234e860…`, MEA association volume 0.036287, and its original A6 comparison. Its [transfer account](../results/engine-3e83e19c-adoption/README.md) preserves those identities. The current #215 record, `00e77608…` at association volume 0.036305439, has separate [one-wheel evidence](../results/engine-3e83e19c-paper-evidence/README.md).

# Question

Did each Engine adoption preserve the numbers it was checked against, and which numerical solver supplied the A7 calculations?

# Result

All three transfers reproduced their compared quantities. The first two checked 152 F1 quantities only. The third, to Engine 3e83e19c, checked every then-current result value reported by the manuscript and changed none of them: all 4,595 compared values are bitwise equal, and the 146 phase-family states of A7 and A6 keep identical classifications and trial outcomes. The only changed values are two seeded split attempts for the A6 comparison fit in supplement Table S10; issue #203 accepted them as disclosed numerical changes. The [current #215 default-path replay](../joint-recalibration/index.qmd#numerical-reproduction) is a separate check.

# Basis and method

Each transfer compares installed merged-commit wheels on the same declared states. F1 is the earlier density-corrected parameter record, not A7. The retained comparison records bind the parameter document, declarations and both wheels.

The 23 October 3e83e19c transfer check reran the existing producers with only their output paths redirected and compared every value by row identity with relative difference $|y_\mathrm{new}-y_\mathrm{old}|/\max(|y_\mathrm{old}|,|y_\mathrm{new}|,10^{-300})$, gate $10^{-10}$ ($10^{-6}$ for the supplement splits). It covers the F1 reference fit's 152 predictions, both 307-row replays (total costs 148.90525398237165 for A7 and 148.23773148349386 for A6), 712 selected-assessment rows and 452 reductions, 2,019 model-curve values, both 73-state phase families, and the A6 seeded splits at states 21, 63 and 70.

# Values

| Engine commits | Quantities compared | Bitwise equal | Worst relative difference (1) | Record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 84ca269d → 21e761c3 | 152 | 152 | 0 | [Comparison](../results/engine-21e761c3-adoption/comparison.json) |
| 21e761c3 → 8298c602 | 152 | 13 | 2.89e-12 | [Comparison](../results/engine-8298c602-adoption/comparison.json) |
| 8298c602 → 3e83e19c | 4,595 values and 146 phase states | 4,595 values; 146 states identical | 0 | [Check](../results/engine-3e83e19c-adoption/adoption-check.json) |

The 8298c602 transfer covers 152 F1 quantities within 2.9 × 10⁻¹² relative difference. It does not qualify every retained F1 result on that wheel.

The A6 seeded splits were computed on Engine 21e761c3. On 3e83e19c, 101 of their 129 values agree within 3.9 × 10⁻¹⁰, and 28 values change in two attempts:

| A6 state, start | Engine 21e761c3 | Engine 3e83e19c (retained) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 63, water-rich | failed; $\Delta G/(RT)$ −1.3990 × 10⁻⁴ | converged to the same two-liquid state as the uniform start; $\Delta G/(RT)$ −2.1105128438 |
| 21, uniform | failed; $\Delta G/(RT)$ vs original −1.5415 × 10⁻⁵ | still failed; +4.76 × 10⁻⁷ |

Both attempts were already failures on the previous pin, 8298c602. The state-63 change makes the two seeded starts at that state agree. The state-21 values belong to a failed solve and carry no physical meaning. Neither changes a number for the historical A7 parameters, a classification, or a fitted or compared quantity. The `3e83e19c` values are retained for Table S10 ([decision](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/203#issuecomment-6361213910)).

The Engine diff between 8298c602 and 3e83e19c changes no equation, species or phase support, reaction convention or observation operator these declarations select. It changes numerical methods: the stability-polish step limit (the Engine #811 fix), association Newton damping, physical-mole recovery, energy-action caching, and refusal of a phase-amount guess that the old interface ignored. The [adoption record](../results/engine-3e83e19c-adoption/README.md) lists each commit.

# Limits and evidence type

This is numerical verification, not physical validation. The earlier source snapshot was refused on both earlier wheels for its missing ionic-dispersion declaration; it supplies no prediction comparison. The 3e83e19c check does not recompute the conditional standard errors and correlations of either fit, which are local diagnostics of the original fits, or the historical predecessor records; they keep their original Engine provenance.

# Records

The pinned Engine is merged commit `3e83e19ccc771b51d8ebc038931ab25192f4c5b5`, wheel SHA-256 `0d08dff9be39fb8fc9018119c47612f53d823cd0e456914d7dd44c6941596804`, built from that commit with numpy 2.4.4 and scipy 1.17.1. The previous pin was `8298c6029ebb8b467929badc4a223c580ec591ab`, wheel SHA-256 `8897a0caab9f2508ed642f42c8b5226957fbe7035ed7bfdad71e4166798785b3`. No Engine source checkout is imported. The historical A7 results for `e234e860…` were computed on 8298c602 and reproduced bitwise on 3e83e19c in the 23 October transfer; that comparison does not describe the later #212 refits.

Where the historical 20 October A7 calculations called Ipopt, they used the MA57 linear solver; the 3e83e19c wheel also reports MA57. The wheel selects MA57 when the owner's licensed HSL library loads through `EPCSAFT_HSL_LIBRARY`, and MUMPS otherwise (Engine #605). The login environment has set that library since 18 October 2026, and the [A7 launcher](../results/joint-recalibration-170/amendment-7/run.py.txt) passes the inherited environment to every call. The A7 result files do not store the solver; the [8298c602 transfer comparison](../results/engine-8298c602-adoption/comparison.json), run on the same wheel and machine, records `ma57`. The pin before that, 21e761c3, predates that selection and used [MUMPS 5.6](../results/engine-8298c602-adoption/README.md). The Engine reports MA57 and MUMPS states agreeing within about 10⁻¹¹; this repository has not compared the two solvers on A7. Acknowledgement: HSL, a collection of Fortran codes for large-scale scientific computation. <https://www.hsl.rl.ac.uk/>

## Execution record

Transfer commands, timings and installed-wheel checks remain in the linked adoption records. The 3e83e19c check used 15 calls, 238 wall-s and 632 CPU-s at niceness 10 ([checks](../results/engine-3e83e19c-adoption/checks.json)). At that historical transfer commit, pytest passed 95 tests; the four failures were identical on 8298c602 at the base commit.
